column1: # Altin Peak: the mine has collapsed with men pinned behind the rubble.

column3:
The roof came down when
the supports gave way.{page_break}The men are pinned behind
the rubble, and the water
is rising.{page_break}Will you help dig them out?{end_now}
Thank the mountain. Hurry,\nbefore the water wins.{end_wait}
Then go. The mountain keeps\nwhat it likes. It won't\nforgive you.{end_wait}
The roof is unstable. If\nwe dig carelessly, we may\nbring it down again.{end_wait}
Then we brace it first.\nWe can't leave them under\nthere.{end_wait}
I know. I'm afraid we'll\nlose more lives if we rush.\nBut we have to try.{end_wait}
We dig, all of us. Nobody\nstays behind.{end_wait}
You got them out. I\nthought we'd be buried\nalive. Please, take this.{end_wait}
The others are safe now.\nThank you for getting us\nout before the next fall.{end_wait}
